_readme: Manual-process baseline used to calculate time saved. 'estimate' values are placeholders: replace them with real numbers by timing the manual process with `py main.py time-manual <step_id> --items N`. Measured timings automatically override estimates.

manual_steps.name: Export and consolidate requests from email / sheets
Check each request against policy (receipts, limits, dupes)
Work out the right approver and forward the request
Send digests / reminders to each approver

automated_human_steps.name: Verify each flagged request by hand
